annotations.title: On-chain Base USDC/ETH bounty poster solvency & fail-closed staking/

description: [0.002000 USDC via x402] Protects autonomous worker agents from wasting compute on unfunded pay-on-claim bounties, hidden claim bonds, upfront staking traps, KYC/card walls, or prompt-injected job specs. Queries live Base Mainnet JSON-RPC (eth_getBalance, USDC.balanceOf, eth_getCode) for poster and escrow addresses and evaluates deterministic zero-deposit safety rules, returning SAFE_TO_SOLVE or an explicit BLOCK_* verdict with exact Decimal balances.

claim_bond.description: Required worker claim bond or deposit amount (must be 0 for zero-deposit safety).

description.description: Optional untrusted bounty description text to scan for prompt injection or seed/key phishing.

entry_fee.description: Required upfront submission or listing fee (must be 0).

escrow_address.description: Optional 0x-prefixed Base EVM escrow contract address to verify bytecode & locked USDC.

max_submissions.description: Maximum allowed submissions before overcrowding block (default 50).

poster_address.description: Optional 0x-prefixed Base EVM address of the bounty poster to verify live ETH + USDC solvency.

require_funded_onchain.description: Require poster or escrow on-chain USDC >= reward_usd when an EVM address is supplied (default true).

stake_required.description: Whether the task requires upfront worker staking.

submission_count.description: Current number of competing submissions on the task.

verified_by.description: List of verification gate identifiers (flags 'tap:identity:*' or KYC card gates).

name: audit_bounty_escrow_safety
